Plot weights on group-time average treatment effects

Source: R/twfeweights.R
ggtwfeweights.mp_weights_obj.Rd

Scatter plot of the weights from twfe_weights(), attO_weights() or att_simple_weights() (horizontal axis) against the estimated \(ATT(g,t)\) (vertical axis), with pre- and post-treatment cells in different colors.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mp_weights_obj'
ggtwfeweights(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An object of class mp_weights_obj.

...

Not used.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

data(mpdta, package = "did")
attgt <- did::att_gt(
  yname = "lemp", tname = "year", idname = "countyreal",
  gname = "first.treat", data = mpdta,
  control_group = "nevertreated", base_period = "universal",
  bstrap = FALSE, cband = FALSE
)
ggtwfeweights(twfe_weights(attgt))
